Game Overview

In Candy Trio, the core idea is straightforward: immerse yourself in Candy Trio's delightful puzzle world. Strategically drag, drop, and rotate vibrant candies to clear the board. As you match three or more, watch them vanish, making room for more sweet surprises. Stay agile to outsmart the board—how long can you keep it clear?
